question: The sum of the present ages of Priya and her younger brother Rohan is 44 years. Four years ago, Priya was twice as old as Rohan was at that time. What is Priya’s current age (in years)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Priya = P, Rohan = R

P + R = 44

4 years ago ⇒ P − 4 = 2(R − 4)

⇒ P = 2R − 4

Substitute ⇒ (2R − 4) + R = 44

⇒ 3R = 48 ⇒ R = 16

⇒ P = 44 − 16 = 28

**∴ Answer = 28 years**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Sum of present ages = 44

4 years ago condition

**Formula used:**

Age relation with time shift

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let Rohan’s present age = x

⇒ Priya’s present age = 44 − x

⇒ 4 years ago:

(44 − x − 4) = 2(x − 4)

⇒ 40 − x = 2x − 8

⇒ 48 = 3x ⇒ x = 16

⇒ Priya’s age = 44 − 16 = 28

**∴ The correct answer is 28 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
